project.name: greenfield-proof
project.description: The smallest greenfield project that exercises every stage of the pipeline: a Python package with one behaviour and its tests, built from nothing in two phases.

configuration.$sourceRepoReadOnly: The workshop repo. READ-ONLY source of dial/, docs/, requirements.txt, .env.example, manifest.md. Never write to it; never copy its .env.

scaffold.description: Package skeleton, SQLite store, test harness

core.description: Ingest, dedup, DIAL classification, escalation, injection proof, review API and portal, cost ledger, run script

stories.title: Scaffold the Python package with a pytest harness
stories.description: Create the project skeleton at the codeline root: requirements.txt declaring pytest, a src/proof/__init__.py package exposing __version__ = '0.1.0', a tests/ directory with tests/test_smoke.py asserting the package imports and __version__ equals '0.1.0', and a .gitignore ignoring .venv and __pycache__. Create a .venv, install requirements, and confirm pytest exits 0.
acceptanceCriteria: Running python -m pytest at the codeline root exits 0 with at least one test collected

stories.title: Add slugify with tests
stories.description: Add src/proof/slug.py exporting slugify(text: str) -> str: lowercase the text, replace runs of whitespace with a single hyphen, drop every character that is not a-z, 0-9 or hyphen, and strip leading and trailing hyphens. Add tests/test_slug.py covering each acceptance criterion. pytest must stay green.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_slug.py exists and covers every criterion above
Running python -m pytest at the codeline root exits 0
